Thanks for the contribution! Before you submit your changes for review, and implementation.
Please take a few moments to look over your code, and make sure that all of the following
requirements are met!

- [ ] You have not used any form of AI generated code, this will be checked*
- [ ] The code builds cleanly without Errors or Warnings.
- [ ] The code does not contain any form of foul language, or slurs
- [ ] Functions are labeled with what they do, and parameters
- [ ] Classes contain a top-level comment explaining what they do

*If you are found to have used AI generated code, future pull requests will be denied.
